description: Send an existing reply draft (from draft_email_reply) from the farm's Email Assistant mailbox. Only works if the farm OWNER turned on "Allow AI assistant to send" in QuailOS Email Assistant settings (off by default), only for owner/admin read/write AI keys, only with confirm: true, and within the farm's daily AI send allowance. Without confirm: true it returns a preview and sends nothing. Every send is logged.

confirm.description: Must be true to actually send. Omit to preview.

name: send_email
